sources.name: VidRift
sources.baseline: Normal mode required · sandbox rejected on interaction
sources.note: User device screenshot on October 15, 2026 shows “Remove sandboxing to enable playback” after touching the player. Startup telemetry and the earlier short advancing-video check did not establish usable sandbox playback. Official VidRift documentation says not to add a sandbox attribute. Normal mode can allow ads, pop-ups and redirects; network access remains unverified.

previousObservation.note: User observed brief playback followed by a white screen and a request to remove the sandbox on October 15, 2026. Treat sandbox mode as incompatible; normal mode is unverified and may allow redirects or pop-ups.
